indicator.definition: Number of persons living in the urban (including estate urban) sector, as recorded by the Census of Population and Housing 2024. Each person is counted in exactly one sector. DCS combines its "Urban" and "Estate Urban" sectors and presents them as "Urban".
indicator.name: Population by sector: Urban (including estate urban)

notices.attribution: Source: Department of Census and Statistics, Sri Lanka, Census of Population and Housing 2024 (provisional GN-level tables).
